salikov-abuse.title: Report on Salikov's abuse of power
salikov-abuse.desc: Application concerning crimes related to abuse of authority and falsification.

crime-report-salikov.title: Crime report against Salikov
crime-report-salikov.desc: Report of a crime committed by Salikov, submitted to the investigative authorities.

witness-testimony-check.title: Application for check of testimony
witness-testimony-check.desc: Demand to check knowingly false testimony given by prosecution witnesses.

obvinenie.title: Formal Charge
obvinenie.desc: Charge under Art. 159(4) of the Criminal Code of the Russian Federation. Contains three mutually exclusive damage figures (from 39 to 42 million RUB), while the damage is counted twice — to the company and to the shareholders. The real payment of 12.5 million RUB is not deducted from the amount at all, and the investigation's conclusions directly contradict the final rulings of arbitration courts.

obvinenie-serbian.title: Formal Charge - Version for Serbia
obvinenie-serbian.desc: The version of the formal charge presented to the Serbian judicial authorities as part of the extradition proceedings for a merits review of the surrender request.

obvinenie-errors-final.title: Charge Analysis - Defence Objections
obvinenie-errors-final.desc: A page-by-page analysis of the indictment prepared by the defence: factual errors, internal contradictions, contradictions with final arbitration rulings, and procedural violations are identified.

international-search-warrant.title: International Wanted Order (Red Notice Basis)
international-search-warrant.desc: The order to list the person as internationally wanted — the basis for the request to issue an Interpol Red Notice. Issued one month after the in absentia arrest on 27.12.2024.

international-search-warrant-serbian.title: International Wanted Order - Version for Serbia
international-search-warrant-serbian.desc: The translation/version of the international wanted order presented to the Serbian authorities as part of the extradition file — linked with the Russian original.

search-warrant.title: Wanted Order
search-warrant.desc: The domestic wanted order issued on 27.12.2024, despite the fact that the applicant's location in Serbia was known to the investigation. Violates Art. 210 of the Criminal Procedure Code of the Russian Federation.

search-warrant-serbian.title: Wanted Order - Version for Serbia
search-warrant-serbian.desc: The version of the wanted order sent to the Serbian authorities for use in the extradition proceedings.

arrest-warrant.title: Arrest Order (In Absentia)
arrest-warrant.desc: The in absentia arrest order issued by the Tverskoy District Court of Moscow on 27.12.2024 without notice to or participation of the accused.

arrest-warrant-serbian.title: Arrest Order - Version for Serbia
arrest-warrant-serbian.desc: A copy of the arrest order transferred to the Serbian judicial authorities for use in the extradition procedure.

genprokuratura-request.title: Extradition Request from the Russian General Prosecutor's Office
genprokuratura-request.desc: The official request from the General Prosecutor's Office of the Russian Federation for the surrender of D.V. Lagovskii, sent to the competent authorities of the Republic of Serbia. It is the key procedural document of the extradition proceedings.

genprokuratura-request-serbian.title: Extradition Request - Version for Serbia
genprokuratura-request-serbian.desc: The version of the extradition request from the Russian General Prosecutor's Office in the Serbian language — used directly in the Serbian judicial proceedings.

supreme-court-decision.title: Serbian Supreme Court Ruling (11.02.2026)
supreme-court-decision.desc: The Serbian Supreme Court unanimously rejected an extraordinary motion for the protection of legality (11.02.2026). The Court did not examine the defence arguments on the merits, formally exhausting all domestic remedies.

higher-court-decision.title: High Court Decision
higher-court-decision.desc: The Serbian High Court decision in the extradition case — issued on 04.07.2025. It fixed the position of the court of first instance in the national extradition procedure.

appeal-filing.title: Appeal against the surrender ruling
appeal-filing.desc: Appellate complaint against the surrender ruling, filed within the national extradition proceedings on 07.12.2025. It contains arguments on violations of the ECHR and international standards.

minister-appeal-ru.title: Appeal to the Serbian Minister of Justice
minister-appeal-ru.desc: The Russian version of the appeal to the Serbian Minister of Justice demanding a refusal of surrender: ECHR violations, the lack of a fair trial in Russia, and risks to the applicant's life and health are listed.

minister-appeal-sr.title: Appeal to the Serbian Minister of Justice (Serbian)
minister-appeal-sr.desc: The Serbian version of the appeal to the Serbian Ministry of Justice — sent simultaneously with the Russian version; intended for direct consideration by officials.

personal-letter-berisha.title: Personal Appeal to Minister Demi Berisha
personal-letter-berisha.desc: A personal letter to Demi Berisha, the Minister for Human and Minority Rights and Social Dialogue, asking for intervention regarding the human rights threat in the event of extradition.

ombudsman-appeal-ru.title: To the Protector of Citizens of the Republic of Serbia
ombudsman-appeal-ru.desc: The Russian version of the complaint to the Serbian Ombudsman: a detailed description of violations of the right to a fair trial and procedural guarantees during the extradition proceedings.

ombudsman-appeal-sr.title: To the Protector of Citizens of the Republic of Serbia (Serbian)
ombudsman-appeal-sr.desc: The Serbian version of the complaint to the Ombudsman — sent in parallel with the Russian version for direct consideration by the competent body.

ombudsman-complaint-may-2026.title: Ombudsman Complaint (May 2026)
ombudsman-complaint-may-2026.desc: An additional complaint to the Serbian Ombudsman, filed in May 2026 after successive asylum refusals and the completion of the national extradition proceedings.

ombudsman-response.title: Response from the Protector of Citizens of the Republic of Serbia
ombudsman-response.desc: The official response from the Serbian Ombudsman to the complaint about procedural violations during the extradition proceedings. Dated 06.06.2025.

ombudsman-response-2.title: Second Response from the Serbian Ombudsman
ombudsman-response-2.desc: The second official response from the Serbian Ombudsman regarding the complaint about violations during the extradition proceedings.

UNHCR-letter.title: Letter to the UNHCR (21.04.2026)
UNHCR-letter.desc: An appeal to the Office of the UN High Commissioner for Refugees: description of the risks in the event of extradition to Russia, the threat of torture and political persecution, and the lack of effective domestic protection. Sent 21.04.2026.

ministry-receipt.title: Confirmation of Receipt by the Serbian MoJ
ministry-receipt.desc: Official confirmation of receipt of the defence appeal by the Serbian Ministry of Justice on 27.05.2025. Serves as evidence of proper notification of the state body.

vucic-admin-response.title: Response from the Serbian Presidential Administration (19.05.2026)
vucic-admin-response.desc: Response from the General Secretariat of the President: the appeal was forwarded to the Serbian Ministry of Justice without a review on the merits — 19.05.2026.

vucic-letter.title: Letter to the President of Serbia, Aleksandar Vučić
vucic-letter.desc: A direct appeal to the President of Serbia, Aleksandar Vučić, asking for intervention in the extradition proceedings and to prevent surrender in the face of unrebutted evidence of political motivation.

eurointegration-ministry-letter.title: Appeal to the Serbian European Integration Ministry
eurointegration-ministry-letter.desc: Appeal to the Serbian Ministry for European Integration: request to note that surrender contradicts the standards of the rule of law and Serbia's obligations within its European integration course.

vucic-letter-2026.title: Letter to President Aleksandar Vučić (May 2026)
vucic-letter-2026.desc: A new appeal to President Vučić after the exhaustion of judicial remedies, emphasizing the risk of mobilization and the connection with Ukraine by birth.

obavestenje.title: Official Notice (Obaveštenje)
obavestenje.desc: A formal notice from the Serbian authorities regarding the status of the extradition or asylum process.

lagovskii-dmitrii-asylum-decision.title: Asylum Office Decision (23.02.2026)
lagovskii-dmitrii-asylum-decision.desc: Initial refusal of asylum and subsidiary protection to D.V. Lagovskii by the Serbian Asylum Office — issued on 23.02.2026 without a proper risk assessment for return to Russia.

asylum-commission-decision.title: Asylum Commission Decision (23.03.2026)
asylum-commission-decision.desc: Decision of the Serbian Asylum Commission rejecting the asylum appeal — 23.03.2026. The only remaining instance is the Serbian Administrative Court; the case is pending.

zeleni-front-letter.title: Letter to 'Zeleni Front'
zeleni-front-letter.desc: An appeal to the Serbian 'Zeleni Front' party asking for support in raising public awareness around the case and drawing attention to the human rights violation.

ssp-letter.title: Letter to the SSP Party
ssp-letter.desc: A letter to the Party of Freedom and Justice (Stranka slobode i pravde, SSP) outlining the facts of the case and asking for a public statement against the unlawful extradition.

nps-letter.title: Letter to the NPS Party
nps-letter.desc: A letter to the People's Movement of Serbia (Narodni pokret Srbije, NPS) with a description of the case and a request to use parliamentary and public mechanisms for protection against extradition.

eu-delegation-letter.title: Letter to the EU Delegation in Serbia
eu-delegation-letter.desc: An appeal to the Delegation of the European Union in Serbia and the European Commission asking for pressure to prevent a surrender that contradicts European human rights standards. Sent 20.04.2026.

apellyatsiya-mosoblsud.title: Appellate Order from the Moscow Region Court
apellyatsiya-mosoblsud.desc: The appellate order of the Moscow Region Court in the criminal case. It modified the decision of the first instance, reducing the terms and making them suspended. Effectively, nothing was changed.

prigovor-achkasovu.title: Conviction of Achkasov et al.
prigovor-achkasovu.desc: A conviction against other defendants in the case, used by the investigation as prejudice applied to D.V. Lagovskii. Within this case, such prejudice is not applicable.

case-A41-20164-2022-20250512.title: Court Order (12.05.2025)
case-A41-20164-2022-20250512.desc: The final court order in case A41-20164/2022 dated 12.05.2025 — officially closes the arbitration proceedings.

case-A41-20164-2022-20250124.title: Cassation Decision (24.01.2025)
case-A41-20164-2022-20250124.desc: The Arbitration Court of the Moscow District rejected the cassation complaint on 24.01.2025, upholding the decision on the legality of the transaction to sell the plot of JSC 'FEZ'.

case-A41-20164-2022-20240913.title: Appellate Order (13.09.2024)
case-A41-20164-2022-20240913.desc: The 10th Arbitration Appellate Court confirmed the decision of 27.06.2024: the transaction was recognized as lawful, and damage to shareholders was not proven — 13.09.2024.

case-A41-20164-2022-20240627.title: Decision of the Moscow Region Arbitration Court (27.06.2024)
case-A41-20164-2022-20240627.desc: The Moscow Region Arbitration Court on 27.06.2024 recognized the sale and purchase of the JSC 'FEZ' plot as lawful, establishing the absence of damage. A key precedent directly refuting the fraud charge.

arbitration-decision-translation.title: Arbitration Decision - Certified Translation
arbitration-decision-translation.desc: A notarized translation of the arbitration decision of 27.06.2024 into the Serbian language — presented to the Serbian courts as part of the extradition proceedings.

email-khrabrykh-to-interpol-ccf.title: Defence Response to Interpol CCF (28.11.2025)
email-khrabrykh-to-interpol-ccf.desc: A letter from lawyer S.V. Khrabrykh to the Interpol Commission for the Control of Files (CCF) with appendices confirming the applicant's lack of managerial authority — a key argument for challenging the Red Notice.

interpol-ccf-response-red-notice.title: Interpol CCF Letter - Complaint Accepted
interpol-ccf-response-red-notice.desc: Interpol CCF confirms the registration of the complaint against the Red Notice (case CCF/135/R1610.25) and the start of a check of the notice's compliance with Interpol Rules. Dated 28.10.2025.

zelensky-letter.title: Letter to President Volodymyr Zelenskyy
zelensky-letter.desc: An appeal to the President of Ukraine asking for the protection of a Ukrainian native who faces extradition to Russia and possible forced mobilization for the war against his homeland.

zvernennya.title: Appeal to the Ukrainian Authorities
zvernennya.desc: An official appeal to the Ukrainian state bodies regarding the extradition case and the threat to the life and safety of a Ukrainian native.

opu-letter.title: Response from the Office of the President of Ukraine
opu-letter.desc: An official response (No. 023520) from the Office of the President of Ukraine regarding the received appeal.

repeat-zvernennya.title: Repeat Appeal to the Ukrainian Authorities
repeat-zvernennya.desc: An additional appeal providing new evidence of the risk of forced mobilization and the humanitarian aspect of the case.

zvernennya-president-2026-05-25-pdf.title: Appeal to the President of Ukraine (25.05.2026, PDF)
zvernennya-president-2026-05-25-pdf.desc: Official appeal to the President of Ukraine in PDF format.

opu-letter-022990.title: Response from the Office of the President of Ukraine No. 022990
opu-letter-022990.desc: Official letter from the Office of the President of Ukraine dated 28.05.2026.

consulate-citizenship-correspondence-202.title: Correspondence with the Consulate of Ukraine on Citizenship Issues (29.05.2026)
consulate-citizenship-correspondence-202.desc: Documents confirming communication with the Consulate of Ukraine.

repeat-zvernennya-president-2026-05-29-p.title: Repeat Appeal to the President of Ukraine (29.05.2026, PDF)
repeat-zvernennya-president-2026-05-29-p.desc: Repeated official appeal in PDF format.

mosgorsud-2025-10-16.title: Moscow City Court: Response to the Art. 125 CCP RF Complaint
mosgorsud-2025-10-16.desc: Response from the Moscow City Court regarding the complaint, where the return of the material is reported and no substantive protection on the merits of the arguments is given.

mosgorsud-rozysk-refusal.title: Moscow City Court: Inability to Respond due to Wanted Listing
mosgorsud-rozysk-refusal.desc: The Court directly refers to formal shortcomings and the wanted status as a ground for not considering the appeal on the merits.

tver-access-refusal.title: Tverskoy Court: Denial of Access to Justice
tver-access-refusal.desc: A document from the Tverskoy Court confirming the denial of effective access to judicial protection regarding complaints related to criminal prosecution.

kassatsiya-refusal.title: Cassation Refusal
kassatsiya-refusal.desc: A cassation refusal, maintaining the same pattern: no review of the arguments on the merits.

tver-complaint-refusal-1.title: Tverskoy Court: Refusal to Accept the Complaint
tver-complaint-refusal-1.desc: The first refusal by the Tverskoy Court to accept the complaint for consideration.

tver-complaint-refusal-2.title: Tverskoy Court: Repeated Refusal to Accept the Complaint
tver-complaint-refusal-2.desc: A repeated refusal to accept a similar complaint, indicating the systemic nature of the judicial block.

shchelkovo-return-order.title: Shchelkovo Court: Order on the Return of the Art. 125 Complaint
shchelkovo-return-order.desc: Order of 20.06.2025 on the return of the complaint regarding the inaction of the Investigative Committee instead of its review on the merits.

shchelkovo-response-697.title: Shchelkovo Court: Response No. 697/2025
shchelkovo-response-697.desc: A court letter stating that the Art. 125 CCP RF complaint was returned. This is no longer judicial protection but notice of a procedural dead end.

mitrokhina-otvety.title: Mitrokhina: All Responses
mitrokhina-otvety.desc: A compiled PDF with the template responses from the Moscow Region Prosecutor's Office. It best shows the systemic refusal to examine arguments on the merits.

mitrokhina-response-13.title: Mitrokhina: Response No. 13
mitrokhina-response-13.desc: A formal response from the Moscow Region Prosecutor's Office: arguments about the unlawful prosecution are not dealt with on the merits.

mitrokhina-response-31.title: Mitrokhina: Response No. 31 with Forwarding to the GSU MVD
mitrokhina-response-31.desc: A response in which the appeal is effectively forwarded to the same investigative block that is the subject of the complaint.

prokuror-mo-response.title: Response from the Moscow Region Prosecutor to the Complaint
prokuror-mo-response.desc: A response from the regional prosecutor's office on a complaint received from the General Prosecutor's Office: there is again no independent assessment of the defence arguments.

prokopenko-otvety.title: Prokopenko: General Prosecutor's Office Responses
prokopenko-otvety.desc: Official responses from the General Prosecutor's Office dated 17.03.2026: the complaints are considered formally, without a legal analysis of key arguments.

genprok-ogr-154993-response.title: General Prosecutor's Office: Response to Complaint OGR-154993-26
genprok-ogr-154993-response.desc: The General Prosecutor's Office response to the complaint about disagreement with previous responses: additional review was rejected, arguments were reduced to ones already 'checked'.

prokuratura-no-reply-response.title: Moscow Region Prosecutor: Response on 'Unreceived Responses'
prokuratura-no-reply-response.desc: A response from the Moscow Region Prosecutor's Office where, instead of solving the problem, it is explained that the previous appeals were allegedly already considered.

mitrokhina-forward-to-gsu-2026-04-20.title: Moscow Region Prosecutor: Forwarding of the Complaint against Mitrokhina to the GSU
mitrokhina-forward-to-gsu-2026-04-20.desc: A cover letter dated 20.04.2026 with which the complaint about inaction and cover-up was effectively sent to the same investigative block.

mitrokhina-response-2026-04-23.title: Moscow Region Prosecutor: Mitrokhina Response of 23.04.2026
mitrokhina-response-2026-04-23.desc: A response regarding the appeals of 17.02.2026 and 20.03.2026, in which the prosecution reproduces the investigation's version and does not give an independent assessment of the arguments.

kuznetsov-forward-to-gsu.title: Moscow Region Prosecutor: Forwarding of the Complaint against Kuznetsov to the GSU
kuznetsov-forward-to-gsu.desc: Formal forwarding of the complaint about the inaction of the department head back into the MVD system whose actions are being challenged.

prokuratura-mo-response-16-4-469-2025.title: Moscow Region Prosecutor: Response No. 16/4-469-2025
prokuratura-mo-response-16-4-469-2025.desc: Response from the regional prosecutor's office where the complaint about inaction and case fabrication was again reduced to a template confirmation of the investigation's position.

mitrokhina-all-responses-bundle.title: Mitrokhina Responses - Compiled Bundle
mitrokhina-all-responses-bundle.desc: A compiled file with a series of formal responses from the Moscow Region Prosecutor's Office regarding appeals about the unlawful criminal prosecution. It clearly shows the repetition of formulations and the lack of a reaction on the merits.

response-lagovskiy-2026-05-25.title: Prosecutor's Response to the Crime Report (25.05.2026)
response-lagovskiy-2026-05-25.desc: Yet another formal response from the prosecution to the crime report. Does not contain an analysis of the arguments and reproduces standard formulations aimed at concealing the violations of its employees.

zamgenprok-response-2026-05-27.title: Deputy General Prosecutor's Response to the Crime Report (27.05.2026)
zamgenprok-response-2026-05-27.desc: The General Prosecutor's Office of the Russian Federation response to the crime report. The country's highest supervisory body fully reproduces the investigation template, ignoring the facts of falsifications. This is clear evidence that the system protects its own at all levels.

zamgenprok-response-salikov.title: Deputy General Prosecutor's Response on the Salikov Case
zamgenprok-response-salikov.desc: A critically important response from the Deputy General Prosecutor of the Russian Federation, maintaining the investigation's version despite detailed evidence of falsifications in the investigation under Salikov's leadership.

prosecutor-mo-baklitskiy-response-2026-0.title: Response from the Moscow Region Prosecutor (Baklitskiy) of 25.05.2026
prosecutor-mo-baklitskiy-response-2026-0.desc: Another formal response from the Moscow Region Prosecutor's Office, signed by Baklitskiy.

svod-otvetov-mitrokhinoy.title: Summary of Mitrokhina’s responses
svod-otvetov-mitrokhinoy.desc: Collected package of similar responses from the Moscow Region Prosecutor’s Office signed by Mitrokhina, showing the lack of substantive review of the defence arguments.

prokuror-mo-baklitskiy-response-2026-05-.title: Moscow Region Prosecutor’s Office response signed by Baklitskiy (25.05.2026)
prokuror-mo-baklitskiy-response-2026-05-.desc: A response concerning Lagovskii’s complaints about concealment of the crime report and inaction on the review materials.

chugunkov-response-660170.title: Chugunkov: Response to the Crime Report No. 3/267704660170
chugunkov-response-660170.desc: A template MVD response to the crime report regarding investigator Salikov. Arguments are not dealt with on the merits. Reflects the systemic practice of protecting 'one's own' officials against the facts.

chugunkov-response-751007.title: Chugunkov: Response to the Crime Report No. 3/267704751007
chugunkov-response-751007.desc: A second identical response from Chugunkov, but with a different signature. The complaint about investigator Salikov's crime was considered formally, without a factual analysis. Confirms that the system protects its own regardless of anything.

kuznetsov-response-2025-06-25.title: Kuznetsov: Response of 25.06.2025
kuznetsov-response-2025-06-25.desc: One of a series of identical brush-offs from the GSU MVD regarding complaints about procedural violations and inaction in the case.

kuznetsov-response-2025-07-20.title: Kuznetsov: Response of 20.07.2025
kuznetsov-response-2025-07-20.desc: A repeated template brush-off in criminal case No. 42401460225000036 without a review of the arguments on the merits.

kuznetsov-response-2025-08-01.title: Kuznetsov: Response of 01.08.2025
kuznetsov-response-2025-08-01.desc: Yet another identical response from the GSU MVD, confirming the systemic rather than accidental nature of the formal consideration of complaints.

kuznetsov-reply-2025-07-14.title: Kuznetsov: Response of 14.07.2025
kuznetsov-reply-2025-07-14.desc: Response from the head of the 6th department of the SCh GSU MVD MO E.I. Kuznetsov dated July 14, 2025. The fourth response in the series. Contains a standard refusal formula without a review of the arguments on the merits.

kuznetsov-response-2025-08-14.title: Kuznetsov: Response of 14.08.2025
kuznetsov-response-2025-08-14.desc: Repeated GSU MVD response without a review of the arguments on the merits.

kuznetsov-response-2025-08-20.title: Kuznetsov: Response of 20.08.2025
kuznetsov-response-2025-08-20.desc: Yet another GSU MVD response without changes on the merits.

kuznetsov-response-2025-09-01.title: Kuznetsov: Response of 01.09.2025
kuznetsov-response-2025-09-01.desc: A template GSU MVD response, witnessing the continuous lack of effective protection.

upch-response-1.title: Ombudsman Response with Forwarding to the Moscow Region Prosecutor's Office
upch-response-1.desc: The Ombudsman's office reported that it shares the concern but does not intervene on the merits itself and forwards the appeal to the Moscow Region Prosecutor's Office.

upch-response-2.title: Second Ombudsman Response
upch-response-2.desc: A repeated response on the Ombudsman line. Used as part of a chain of formal responses without effective protection.

upch-l-9669.title: Ombudsman: Response No. L-9669
upch-l-9669.desc: A numbered response from the Ombudsman's office, published as an element of the general correspondence without a legal result.

upch-l-9901.title: Ombudsman: Response No. L-9901
upch-l-9901.desc: Yet another numbered Ombudsman response from the same appeal track.

president-registration-11184185.title: Russian Presidential Administration: Registration and Formal Response No. I-15688
president-registration-11184185.desc: A letter from the Office for Handling Citizens' Appeals: the appeal was registered, then follows a standard reference to Law No. 59-FZ instead of a solution to the problem.

fsb-salikov-forwarded.title: FSB: Receipt and, Likely, Further Forwarding
fsb-salikov-forwarded.desc: By content, the record fixes not an investigation, but the bureaucratic passage of the appeal through the FSB line.

fsb-upch-l-9669.title: FSB: Forwarding via the Ombudsman No. L-9669
fsb-upch-l-9669.desc: A numbered response on the Ombudsman line which in sense reflects not the protection of rights but the further forwarding of the appeal through the FSB circuit.

fsb-upch-l-9901.title: FSB: Forwarding via the Ombudsman No. L-9901
fsb-upch-l-9901.desc: Yet another numbered response from the same circuit, confirming the bureaucratic forwarding without a review on the merits.

sf-response.title: Federation Council: Response from the Klishas Committee Office
sf-response.desc: Response from the office of the Federation Council Committee on Constitutional Legislation. Formally explains the law but does not give a substantive protection on the questions raised.

inspection-protocol-analysis.title: Inspection Protocol Analysis
inspection-protocol-analysis.desc: A page-by-page analysis of the investigative protocol of 17.12.2022, showing where quotes and documents regarding the transaction were used in a distorted context.

protocol-58.title: Protocol No. 58 of the JSC 'FEZ' Board of Directors
protocol-58.desc: A corporate act related to the approval and parameters of the transaction of 28.12.2021. Important not as an investigative document but as primary material on the transaction itself and the distribution of powers within the company.

land-sale-contract.title: Land Sale Agreement
land-sale-contract.desc: The primary document of the disputed transaction of 28.12.2021. It was precisely the legality of this transaction that was subsequently confirmed by final arbitration court rulings.

legal-services-contract.title: Legal Services Agreement
legal-services-contract.desc: A retainer agreement for legal services, confirming that Lagovskii worked as an outside contractor rather than an executive or staff member of JSC 'FEZ'.

legal-services-contract-2018.title: JSC 'FEZ' Legal Services Agreement of 31.01.2018
legal-services-contract-2018.desc: Full retainer agreement for legal services, confirming that the relationship with JSC 'FEZ' was built as an outside contract rather than a labor or management function.

egrip-extract-2025.title: Sole Proprietor Registry Extract (EGRIP) of 07.06.2025
egrip-extract-2025.desc: An extract confirming sole-proprietor status and thus the outside rather than corporate nature of Lagovskii's work for the company.

kuznetsov-appendices-1-16.title: Appendices 1-16 to the Complaint against Kuznetsov
kuznetsov-appendices-1-16.desc: A package of appendices to the complaint about the inaction of the head of the 6th department of the GSU MVD. Inside are separate pieces of evidence in the case, including judicial and procedural materials.

kusp-palkin-materials.title: KUSP and Supporting Materials regarding Palkin's Statement
kusp-palkin-materials.desc: A selection of materials from the package of appendices: the KUSP registration notice, related documents, and evidence on the initial launch of the criminal case.

article-125-search-warrant-complaint.title: Complaint against the Actions of the Investigator
article-125-search-warrant-complaint.desc: Complaint about an illegal search carried out despite a direct court ban.

search-refusal-order.title: Shchelkovo Court Decision Directly Banning the Search
search-refusal-order.desc: Investigator Salikov ignored this decision, carried out an illegal search, and then hid all this from the Tverskoy Court.

inspection-protocol-iphone-sorokina.title: Inspection Protocol for Appraiser Sorokina's iPhone
inspection-protocol-iphone-sorokina.desc: The document contains the appraiser's correspondence with management about adjusting figures for completely different clients ('Demin Limited' and a mortgage borrower). Lagovskii is not mentioned in them even once. The investigation attempts to pass off someone else's practice as evidence in this case, using assumptions instead of facts.

inspection-protocol-crm-otsenka-i-pravo.title: Inspection Protocol for the CRM Database of 'Ocenka i pravo' LLC
inspection-protocol-crm-otsenka-i-pravo.desc: A key document of the prosecution. Contains the only phrase of Lagovskii: 'the price must be real'. The investigation interprets it as suspicious, although it is a direct requirement of legality. In the CRM, there is not a single instruction on falsification, discussion of specific figures or methods. Arguments about a 'suspicious visit' for the report and post delivery times are refuted by the facts: the report was picked up by a driver for another case, and the delivery times are fixed by Russian Post tracking numbers.

mitrokhina-registration.title: Moscow Region Prosecutor: Confirmation of the Appeal's Receipt
mitrokhina-registration.desc: Automatic email stating that the appeal was received by the Moscow Region Prosecutor's Office and was assigned an ID.

mitrokhina-number-assigned.title: Moscow Region Prosecutor: Assignment of the Registration Number
mitrokhina-number-assigned.desc: Automatic notice of the registration of the appeal under number VO-22508-26-20460001.

appl-prokopenko-draft.title: Draft Appeal to the General Prosecutor's Office (Prokopenko)
appl-prokopenko-draft.desc: Draft appeal with detailed legal arguments against the formal prosecutorial refusal.

kuznetsov-inactivity-complaint.title: Complaint to the Moscow Region Prosecutor on Kuznetsov's Inaction
